items.title: Nebius and Vantage Plan Nvidia-Powered AI Infrastructure Deployment in South Wales
items.summary: Vantage Data Centers (AMEX:VNTG) and Nebius (NASDAQ:NBIS) have agreed to deploy Nvidia-powered artificial intelligence infrastructure at Vantage’s CWL1 data centre campus in Newport, Wales, expanding the region’s role in the UK’s growing AI infrastructure market. The agreement represents the first announced commercial capacity commitment within the South Wales AI Growth Zone.
